text: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥21日在北京会见2026年国际科学理事会中期会员大会暨北京科学对话部分外宾。
text_en: Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met in Beijing on the 21st with some foreign guests attending the 2026 International Science Council Mid-Term Members' Meeting and the Beijing Science Dialogue.
